page.content:
Moon-raising sister of Celestia who was once Nightmare Moon.

How Princess Luna connects

  • Character: Nightmare Moon — Nightmare Moon is Princess Luna's armored exile-self.
  • Location: Equestria — Princess Luna shares Equestria's throne and raises the moon.

What is Princess Luna?

Princess Luna raises the moon, returns from a thousand-year exile as Nightmare Moon, and rejoins Celestia on the Canterlot throne after the Mane Six use the Elements of Harmony.

Key threads lead to Nightmare Moon and Equestria.
